ops.note: Quiz options that are a bare digit or a bare letter must not show a ⟶ line that gives the answer away (OptionArabic in src/features/lesson.tsx prints translitLine under every option). Suppress ⟶ for digit-only and single-letter options. Examples: d7q2 'How do you write 7 in Arabic digits?' options ٧ ٦ ٨ ٢ now read sabʿa / sitta / thamāniya / ithnān; d38q7 'which letter is the ʿayn' shows 'ʿ' under ع (and an empty ⟶ under أ). Arabic options and answer keys unchanged.

proseTranslit (src/lang/ar/tap.ts, namedBefore rule): when a bare letter or mark is dropped because its name is written just before it, also drop the space before it and any brackets left empty around it. Expected ⟶: day 7 intro '… plus hamza, tāʾ marbūṭa and alif maqṣūra.' (not 'hamza , … maqṣūra .'); day 34 / day 58 quiz[6].prompt 'Which word ends in tāʾ marbūṭa?'; day 36 quiz[6].prompt '… which consonant carries the sukūn?'; day 46 'Which word begins with ghayn?'; day 49 'Which word has qāf, the deep k said at the back of the throat?'; day 50 'Which word begins with ghayn, the soft gargle?'; day 57 'Which word has sīn, the light s?'; day 60 'Which word has ʿayn, the sound from deep in the throat?'. Source prompts unchanged; do not print 'sīn (sīn)'.

Clitic hyphen (cliticReading in src/lang/ar/tap.ts): hyphenate a one-letter proclitic wa-/fa-/bi-/li-/ka- whenever the line's seg (or tap) gloss for the word is clitic + word ('and …', 'so/because …', 'for …', 'with/in …'), also when the bare stem is an inflected form not found as such in the glossary. Today only exact glossary stems whose glossary gloss starts with a clitic word split. Examples: watafhamu → wa-tafhamu, faṣadīquka → fa-ṣadīquka, wajubnan → wa-jubnan (d13-20); wakīluwayni → wa-kīluwayni, biʾarbaʿimiʾa → bi-arbaʿimiʾa, liʿāʾilatinā → li-ʿāʾilatinā (d21-30); waʿuyūnuhā → wa-ʿuyūnuhā, fafī → fa-fī, wakibba wamanāqīsh → wa-kibba wa-manāqīsh (d31-40); waṣawtuka → wa-ṣawtuka, liʾannakumā → li-annakumā, wasaʾasʾalukum → wa-saʾasʾalukum (d41-50); wakāmīrā → wa-kāmīrā, lishakhṣayni → li-shakhṣayni, wa-bithalāthīna → wa-bi-thalāthīna (d51-60). LEAD DECIDES بِخَيْر: days-21-30 checker wants bi-khayr (the round-3 brief's own model; allow 'fine (lit. in goodness)' to count), days-51-60 checker wants bikhayr kept whole (one-word gloss, like بِجَانِبِ 'next to').

Double clitic before a name: وَلِسَامِي (seg 'and for Sami') prints 'wa-Lisāmī'; split both clitics and capitalise the name, not the clitic: 'wa-li-Sāmī' (day 31 reading: 'Li-Laylā qiṭṭa smuhā Lūlū, wa-li-Sāmī akh wa-ukht.'). Same pattern for any wa-/fa- + li-/bi- + name, e.g. وَلِصَدِيقِكِ → wa-li-ṣadīqiki (day 28).

Names in lower case in ⟶: a word segged '· name' must be capitalised even when the form also has a common-word sense. شِيكَاغُو → 'fī Shīkāghū' (day 32 dialogue.lines[0], reading); الْأُسْتَاذ كَرِيم → 'Al-ustādh Karīm' (speaker labels days 36, 39, 41, 42, 43, 50) and 'Yā ustādh Karīm' (day 41 reading). In the speaker label الْأُسْتَاذ كَرِيم the word is always the name.

FIXED_TRANSLIT for الله (src/core/translit.ts) drops a written case vowel mid-phrase: اللّٰهُ يُسَلِّمُكِ يَا لَيْلَى prints 'Allāh yusallimuki' (day 43 dialogue.lines[14]) and 'allāh yusallimuki' (day 43 dialogue.culture). Keep the written vowel when the word is not in pause: 'Allāhu yusallimuki yā Laylā!'; pause and waṣl readings such as 'in shāʾa llāh', 'al-ḥamdu lillāh' must stay as they are.

The s·h / d·h / k·h / t·h separator dot (src/core/translit.ts) is inserted after a hyphen/tatweel, where no consonant precedes the h: the day 60 intro shows bare suffixes ـهُ, ـهَا as '-·hu', '-·hā'. Expected '-hu', '-hā'; keep the real separator in 'tajid·hā' (day 60 dialogue.lines[6]).

notesForLead: عَلِي (days-11-20 #1): the leak is not from auto.json (the app never reads it) but from widen() in src/lang/ar/tap.ts: the day-18 seg is pos 'name', and widen() prepends the day-81 seg 'Ali (name; Muhammad Ali ruled Egypt in the 1800s)', which has no '· name' pos, as if it were a common-word sense. The scoped day:18 op fixes day 18; giving the day-81 seg (content/days/day81.json dialogue.lines[6]) the pos 'name' would remove the cause (outside P1's chunks). The '*' op only sets the plain default for places with no seg sense of their own; عَلِي is currently tapped only on days 18 and 81.
بِخَيْر day:52 scope also changes quiz[4].options[2] (the scope is per day); the new gloss still names wa-anti, so it is right there too.
بِخَيْر hyphenation: the two checkers disagree (days-21-30 X: bi-khayr; days-51-60 X: bikhayr). Owner/lead must pick one before the clitic engine fix.
